mapper.select:
select id, semester, row_class_name as rowClassName, class_name as className, weekday, section_code as sectionCode, section_text as sectionText, start_section as startSection, end_section as endSection, course_name as courseName, teacher, week_raw as weekRaw, week_text as weekText, week_expanded as weekExpanded, classroom, create_time as createTime from class_timetable
and semester = #{semester}
and teacher like concat('%', #{teacher}, '%')
and ( class_name like concat('%', #{className}, '%') or row_class_name like concat('%', #{className}, '%') )
and classroom like concat('%', #{classroom}, '%')
and course_name like concat('%', #{courseName}, '%')
and ( course_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or teacher like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or class_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or row_class_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or classroom like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and find_in_set(cast(#{week} as char), week_expanded) > 0
order by id desc limit #{limit}

select count(*) as total, count(distinct class_name) as classCount, count(distinct teacher) as teacherCount, count(distinct classroom) as classroomCount, max(create_time) as latestSyncAt from class_timetable
select semester from class_timetable where semester is not null and semester != '' group by semester order by max(create_time) desc, semester desc
mapper.update: create table if not exists class_timetable ( id bigint primary key auto_increment, semester varchar(50) comment '学年学期', row_class_name varchar(100) comment '原始行班级', class_name varchar(100) comment '班级', weekday varchar(20) comment '星期', section_code varchar(20) comment '节次代码', section_text varchar(50) comment '节次', start_section int comment '开始节次', end_section int comment '结束节次', course_name varchar(200) comment '课程名称', teacher varchar(100) comment '教师', week_raw varchar(100) comment '周次原文', week_text varchar(100) comment '周次', week_expanded varchar(255) comment '展开周次', classroom varchar(200) comment '教室', create_time datetime default current_timestamp ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: insert into class_timetable ( semester, row_class_name, class_name, weekday, section_code, section_text, start_section, end_section, course_name, teacher, week_raw, week_text, week_expanded, classroom ) values ( #{semester}, #{rowClassName}, #{className}, #{weekday}, #{sectionCode}, #{sectionText}, #{startSection}, #{endSection}, #{courseName}, #{teacher}, #{weekRaw}, #{weekText}, #{weekExpanded}, #{classroom} )
mapper.update: create table if not exists timetable_academic_credential ( credential_key varchar(80) primary key, username_cipher text not null, password_cipher text not null, updated_at datetime default current_timestamp on update current_timestamp ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4
mapper.select: select credential_key as credentialKey, username_cipher as usernameCipher, password_cipher as passwordCipher, date_format(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt from timetable_academic_credential where credential_key = #{credentialKey}
mapper.insert: insert into timetable_academic_credential ( credential_key, username_cipher, password_cipher, updated_at ) values ( #{credentialKey}, #{usernameCipher}, #{passwordCipher}, now() ) on duplicate key update username_cipher = values(username_cipher), password_cipher = values(password_cipher), updated_at = now()
